name: io_getevents
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_io_getevents, aio_context_t ctx_id, long min_nr, long nr, struct io_event *events, struct timespec *timeout);
description: The io_getevents() system call reads at least a minimum number of asynchronous I/O events and up to a maximum from the specified AIO context's completion queue. It waits for the specified timeout period, or indefinitely if timeout is NULL.

parameters.name: min_nr
parameters.description: Minimum number of events to read

parameters.name: nr
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to read

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Array to store the read events

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout structure for waiting, or NULL to block indefinitely

return_value.success: Returns the number of events read (may be 0 or less than min_nr if timeout expires or interrupted)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Either events or timeout is an invalid pointer
ctx_id is invalid, min_nr is out of range, or nr is out of range
io_getevents() is not implemented on this architecture

bugs: An invalid ctx_id may cause a segmentation fault instead of generating the error EINVAL.
